profile.headline: Software Engineer at IDEMIA
profile.summary:
I build software for regulated, high-stakes environments — most recently accessibility infrastructure across two enterprise platforms at Apple, including a route-level focus management system of reusable React hooks and a CI gate that enforces axe-core standards on every pull request.

Eight years in React, TypeScript, Node.js, and GraphQL across e-commerce (Lowe's — a design system migration spanning 26 frontend applications), fintech (the TurboTax login experience through peak tax season), and healthcare. Outside work I build clinical documentation tooling: FlashNote turns physical therapists' shorthand into structured SOAP notes behind a provider-agnostic LLM layer, with a hallucination detector that flags generated clinical measurements absent from the clinician's input.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Accessibility remediation and infrastructure across two enterprise platforms.
 
• Led a full heading-hierarchy rewrite across both platforms
• Designed a route-level focus management system of reusable React hooks, replacing ad-hoc per-screen handling
• Upstreamed accessibility APIs into the shared design system, ending per-app workarounds for hard-coded heading levels
• Authored accessibility E2E suites and a CI gate enforcing axe-core standards on every pull request
• Cut E2E suite runtime by up to 70% with a cluster-mode mock GraphQL server using container-aware CPU detection
• Shipped GraphQL onboarding data plumbing; resolved production UI, data-display, and localization defects
positions.insights: Accessibility and Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed and optimized the TurboTax login experience in React, serving millions of users through peak tax season.
• Ensured high performance and personalization for a seamless user experience.
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to meet high traffic demands and enhance application visibility.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed, managed, and optimized high traffic ecommerce micro-applications that managed users online order cancellations and modifications. I translated key business requirements into logical software designs, reusable code modules, and detailed unit tests that ensured the security and consistency of online purchases of a Fortune 50 company. Daily tech stack and language usage included JavaScript, React, GraphQL, Redux, Jest.

positions.title: Full Stack Software Developer
positions.description: Built and maintained multiple sites and web applications that served the communication needs of 20,000+ students, staff and employees. As the sole full-time technical employee on the team, I was lead touch-point and decision maker for anything related to our web ecosystem. I managed application and site builds, continuous integration and deployment, development workflow, and any other technical needs that my colleagues or employees identified, all while managing a team of student employees. I lead an initiative to consolidate all web resources into the Javascript and React ecosystem and away from disparate web platforms and technology stacks.

projects.title: FlashNote
projects.description:
TypeScript, React, Next.js, PostgreSQL, Google Vertex AI, Stripe, Tailwind CSS

github.com/Matthew-Nelson/flash-note

- Built HIPAA-compliant AI SaaS application enabling Physical Therapists to generate insurance-compliant SOAP notes from shorthand input, architected to run on Google Cloud Run with an all-Google infrastructure stack (Cloud SQL, Vertex AI) under a single Business Associate Agreement.
- Engineered a centralized Data Access Layer as the single authorization enforcement point across 16 database tables, with immutable audit logging, opaque session-based authentication, and Redis-backed rate limiting.
- Integrated Google Gemini via Vertex AI for clinical note generation with structured prompt engineering optimized for PT-specific terminology and documentation standards.
- Achieved 2,116 tests with 96.9% statement coverage across authentication, billing (Stripe), and note generation domains using Vitest and React Testing Library.

projects.title: Physio AI
projects.description:
TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, Google Gemini, Prompt Engineering

github.com/Matthew-Nelson/physio-ai

- Architected a healthcare platform to HIPAA technical-safeguard requirements with multi-tenant isolation, role-based access control, and comprehensive PHI audit logging across 47 database tables modeled on FHIR resources and USCDI v3 data classes.
- Built a local-first AI agent orchestration system with a generated HTML dashboard, CLI tooling, and a programmatic helper library enabling specialized AI agents (backend, frontend, quality, product) to autonomously pick up, track, and complete stories across 19 epics with enforced workflow gates and git-native audit trails.
- Integrated Google Gemini LLM for AI-powered clinical documentation, enabling automated SOAP note generation with full patient context awareness (history, diagnosis, treatment goals, prior encounters).
- Implemented real-time Range of Motion analysis using MediaPipe Pose Landmarker with 33-point skeletal tracking.
